2014_spells.blade-of-disaster.descriptio: You create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long in a space you can see within range. The blade lasts for the duration. When you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can move the blade up to 30 feet to a space you can see and make up to two melee spell attacks with it.
2014_spells.blade-of-disaster.effectSumm: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.blade-of-disaster.fullDescri: Using 1 bonus action, you create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long in a space you can see within range. The blade lasts for the duration; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, you can make three attacks with the blade instead of two. The blade lasts for the duration; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
